current_english.25:2: "Speak to the sons of Israel and you shall say to them, 'When you enter the land which I am giving to you, then the land which I am giving to you shall rest a Sabbath to the Lord.
current_english.25:55: For to Me the sons of Israel are household servants; these are My servants whom I brought out of the land of Egypt.
current_english.26:1: I am the Lord your God. You shall not make for yourselves handmade objects or carved images, nor shall you set up a pillar for yourselves, nor shall you place a lookout stone in your land to bow down to it; I am the Lord your God.
current_english.26:45: And I will remember their former covenant, when I brought them out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage, in the sight of the nations, to be their God; I am the Lord.
current_english.26:46: These are My judgments and My ordinances, and the law which the Lord gave between Himself and the sons of Israel on Mount Sinai by the hand of Moses.'"

issue: Two linked quotation/speaker issues in Leviticus 25-26: (1) Verse 26:46 closes both nested quotes ('") AFTER a third-person narrator colophon ('which the Lord gave between Himself and the sons of Israel on Mount Sinai by the hand of Moses'), while opening with first-person possessives ('These are My judgments and My ordinances'), creating a speaker-attribution clash inside God's quoted speech to Moses. (2) Chapters 25 and 26 are now the ONLY two chapters out of 1,291 in the entire 70-book edition with odd double-quote counts (Ch 25 = 3, Ch 26 = 1), because the speech opened in 25:2 neither closes at 25:55 nor reopens at 26:1 (unlike Lev 4:35->5:1, Lev 6:23->7:1, and all 37 other cross-chapter speeches in the edition).
proposed_resolution_for_grc_peer: Verify the adopted Greek of Lev 26:45-46: check whether Greek 26:46 actually reads first-person 'My' (μου) on 'judgments' and 'ordinances' or anarthrous/articular nouns, and determine whether '" should close at 26:45 (leaving 26:46 outside quotation marks as a third-person narrator colophon) or remain at 26:46 with an explanatory translator note. Once 26:45-46 is verified, harmonize 25:55 -> 26:1 with Lev 4:35->5:1 and Lev 6:23->7:1 (closing '" at 25:55 and reopening " at 26:1, closing " at 26:45 or 26:46).

current_english.12:8: And the Levites: Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, Machaniah; he and his brothers were over the hands

issue: Verse 12:8 ends with no terminal or internal punctuation ('over the hands'), while 12:9 is a capitalized three-word prepositional fragment ('For the divisions.'). In standalone English it is ambiguous whether 12:9 directly continues 12:8 as one clause ('...were over the hands for the divisions.', requiring lowercase 'for') or stands as an independent verbless/elliptical note after 12:8 (requiring punctuation at 12:8 and optionally a translator note).
proposed_resolution_for_grc_peer: Verify the adopted Greek syntax, punctuation, and verse break of Nehemiah 12:8-9 (note 12:8 already explains 'over the hands', epi ton cheiron): if 12:9 syntactically continues 12:8, lowercase 'For' -> 'for' in 12:9; if 12:9 is a distinct elliptical clause/heading in the adopted Greek, add appropriate terminal punctuation at 12:8 (and note if helpful).
